Checkers

Play English draughts (checkers) with full rules — forced captures, multi-jumps and kinging — against a greedy AI or a friend.

12
Your pieces
12
Opponent pieces
You
Turn

Captures are forced — when a jump is available the game highlights only capturing moves. Kings move diagonally in both directions.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick “Vs computer” or “Two players”, then press New game.
  2. Click one of your pieces — legal destinations light up.
  3. Captures are forced: when a jump is available you must take it, and keep jumping while you can.
  4. Reach the far row to crown a king. First to capture everything wins.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are captures really forced?

Yes. If any of your pieces can capture, you must take a capture — the game only lets you pick capturing moves, and multi-jumps must be completed.

How does a piece become a king?

Any man that reaches the farthest row is crowned a king and can then move and capture diagonally in both directions.

How strong is the computer?

The computer prefers the capture that takes the most pieces and otherwise moves randomly — it plays fast but makes mistakes you can exploit.

How do you win?

You win by capturing all enemy pieces, or when the opponent has no legal move left on their turn.
